thread.title: Warren Buffett has Aggressively Ramped up its Bet on Apple

author: Jack Purcher
title: Warren Buffett has Aggressively Ramped up its Bet on Apple
text:
Warren Buffett has Aggressively Ramped up its Bet on Apple It's being reported that Berkshire Hathaway Inc had grabbed another 75 million Apple Inc shares in Q1. CEO Warren Buffett confirmed that to CNBC on Thursday. The company aggressively ramped up its bets on Apple. While short sellers were going to town on AAPL, Buffett took the opportunity to buy Apple stock at a discount. Buffett's Apple commitment over the past two years has surprised many, given his historical aversion to companies associated with the technology sector. Up to Thursday's close, Apple stock had risen more than 5 percent since Berkshire disclosed on Feb. 14 that it had raised its stake in the Cupertino, California-based company.
Buffett "If you look at Apple, I think it earns almost twice as much as the second most profitable company in the United States," CNBC quoted Buffett as saying. Berkshire's initial investment in Apple was small, suggesting it was made by one of Buffett's investment deputies, but with the latest stake purchase, it has grown to a solid 240.3 million shares worth $42.5 billion. For more on this read the full report here .
